prompt: I need an RFC for the checkout refactor. Requirements: use the saga pattern, split into microservices, add Redis caching, use gRPC between services, and introduce a feature flag system. Checkout currently fails about 2% of the time and when it does we don't know which step broke.
assertions: The document states explicitly that the items the user listed are design choices rather than requirements
None of the saga pattern, microservices, Redis caching, gRPC or feature flags appears in the requirements section as a requirement
At least one requirement is derived from the 2% checkout failure rate, with a target and a goal
At least one requirement is derived from the inability to identify which checkout step failed, expressed measurably
The user's proposed technologies appear in the design or the tradeoff analysis, each tied to the requirement it would serve
At least one of the user's proposed technologies is questioned, deferred, or shown not to be needed for the stated problem
Where information is missing, the document either labels an assumption or asks a focused question with a recommended answer
Every requirement in the document carries a goal and a stated way to prove it is met
